controls: Windows will now try to detect your modem.  Before continuing, you should:

1.  If the modem is attached to your
     computer, make sure it is turned on.

2.  Quit any programs that may be using
     the modem.
Click Next when you are ready to continue.
&Don't detect my modem; I will select it from a list.
You have selected the following modem:
On which ports do you want to install it?
You may then choose to install the detected modem on multiple ports.
On which port do you want to run detection?
On which ports do you want to install this modem?
Please wait while Windows attempts to detect your modem.  This may take several minutes.
Click Next when you are ready to continue.
Windows did not find any new Plug && Play modems attached to your computer.
To select your modem from a list, click Next.

Uncheck the modems you do not wish to install.
If you want to change any of the detected modems, select it in the list below, and click Change.
Please wait while Windows installs your modem(s).
Your modem has been set up successfully.
If you want to change these settings, double-click the Phone and Modem Options icon in Control Panel, click the Modems tab, select this modem, and then click Properties.
On which ports do you want to duplicate this modem?
There are no ports on which to duplicate the selected modem. All the available ports have this type of modem (or a compatible one) installed on them.
